title: Very flimsy and small
text: Very flimsy and small. The little rails on the bottle are annoying and if you are over 6ft tall the desk does not give enough leg room if it is against a wall. I recommend going for a bigger desk. This feels cheap and wobbles like there is no tomorrow

product_metadata.title: Alecono L Shaped Desk Corner Gaming Computer Desk 62inch Home Office Workstation with Large Legroom, Easy to Assemble Writing Table, Black
features: L shaped Desk--L shaped desk can be placed in the corner,not only save space,there is enough desktop space to meet your needs,and by getting 2 L desk together ,you can also form the U shaped workstation for more space.

Large Gaming desk ---(62"+42.5")L×18.9" W: This large L shaped desk enough to hold the computer and three monitors as well as your personal laptop, it meets your remote work during the day and then gaming at night, It enables you to have separate areas for gaming/computing as well as writing/drawing/paperwork.

Enough legroom Home Office Desk---The Large L Shaped Computer Desk without any annoying poles design in the middle which allowed your chair rotating freely. The larger legroom fully releasing your leg, especially when working at tables all day!

Sturdy Workstation ---All the metal tube Upgrade to 25 mm thicker steel and add extra thicker metal tube under the corner desktop to improve the supporting strength. The adjustable foot pad design can keep your desk from shake and shift around for the not level floors.

Easy to assemble and to Clean--All the parts for the L shaped desk are labeled and the assembly tools included, it is easy to assemble following the instruction.Particle board desktop is more sturdy and Scratch & Water-Resistant, easy to clean.
